name.zh: Yochelcionella greenlandica（内模化石形态研究）

scope: Existing planned genus ID; original stylized isolated internal-mould fossil form, principally MGUH27016 holotype. Not living whole animal, hollow original shell, scan, exact specimen replica or new genus variant.

taxon.primary_specimen: MGUH27016, GGU271471, Aftenstjernesoe Formation, Broenlund Fjord Group, central North Greenland
taxon.classification_limit: Helcionelloid mollusc context; no asserted modern gastropod anatomy, orientation or snorkel function.
taxon.context: Lower Cambrian; source interval labels historical, no precise numerical-age claim.

coordinates.origin: Center of lowermost mould footprint at Z=0; presentation datum only, not original life posture.
coordinates.orientation_note: Subapical snorkel projection points toward -Y. Camera front is presentation label, NOT anatomical anterior, which is debated.

scale.basis: Millimeter-scale artistic nominal specimen study, not measured holotype. Figure2 states x35 magnification; do not derive exact dimension from arbitrarily scaled screen image. Inventory hand-scale label not adopted as real size.
scale.world_boundary: Microscopic fossil item: viewer zoom allowed; do not enlarge physical scale silently for scene readability.
scale.dimensions_note: Nominal body footprint Y length 1.05 mm; total bound including short solid projection is reported separately. Shapes are artistic nominal, not measured holotype.

surface_profile.name: palette-only
surface_profile.normal_style: Broad clean fossil-form planes, restrained smooth transitions; two/three readable rugae, not noisy triangulation.
surface_profile.materials: 2–3 subdued warm gray/slate stone-like matte palette, artistic only; no painted SEM photo pixels.

runtime_profile.portability: No external texture/buffer dependencies; maker records exporter/importer versions.

view_plan.greybox_note: Check internal-mould mass, overhanging apex, subapical projection, lateral compression and rugae before polish.
view_plan.final_source: Clean import of exact delivered GLB; same bytes/hash reviewed independently.
view_plan.extra_views: Only targeted close-up if canonical views do not resolve diagnostic feature.

morphology.obligation: One bilaterally symmetric, moderately laterally compressed cap-like internal mould. Broad low oval footprint, rounded apex bent/overhanging toward -Y subapical side. Side silhouette gently sigmoid on opposite supra-apical wall; not spherical limpet, straight traffic cone or complete spiraled snail.

One short integrated subapical snorkel FILL projection, near apex but below its overhang, pointing slightly upward away from -Y wall. Rounded cross-section and mild outward flare; same solid fossil mass. Truncated/soft blunt terminal is preservation-bounded. NO drilled hollow aperture or separate attached cylinder.
morphology.source: Fig2B/D and p5: these specimens phosphatic internal moulds; shell thickness/ornament unknown.

morphology.obligation: Two or three broad restrained lateral comarginal rugae, with first aligned in inclination with snorkel and not wrapping as a uniform ring across subapical face; later rugae continue beneath apex. Preserve a quiet curved cap between ridges. Do not add fine shell ornament, scales, segment seams or ribs copied from Y.gracilis.
Conservative subtly uneven closed mould basal surface, no inferred living mantle cavity, foot, mouth or operculum. Do not create substrate, fossil slab, plinth or stand.
morphology.source: Fossil-form internal mould scope; original aperture outline described oval3:2 but actual full basal surface not pictured in selected holotype panels.

scientific_limits: This is internal mineral mould, not shell exterior. Solid snorkel fill is intentional; hollow tube requires separate evidence and scope change.
Original shell thickness and ornament explicitly unknown in source. No soft animal, eyes, tentacles, muscular foot or mantle invented.
Function/orientation of snorkel debated in primary source; presentation -Y is not claim of inhalant/anterior anatomy.
Original specimen missing/damaged parts must not be reconstructed as exact anatomy. Subtle completed basal closure is technical/art inference, not direct fossil evidence.
Actual fossil color is not inferred from SEM grayscale. No precise measured size claimed; nominal dimensions declared.
Use Fig2A–D holotype as principal multi-view anchor. Fig2E–Q paratypes only variation context; Fig3 Y.gracilis is different species and excluded.
Classification in fossil animal category does NOT make this a living creature model. Counts one existing planned concept only.

art_direction.hierarchy: Dominant bent compressed cap; secondary integrated subapical projection; tertiary broad rugae. Small deliberate asymmetry only for fossil preservation, not low-quality lumpy mesh.
art_direction.construction: Purpose-built continuous surface with integrated fill projection and rounded ridges. No stacked torus rings, boolean-hole fakery, bead chain or noisy decimation.

acceptance_obligations: Maker must inspect source Fig2A–D pixels before making, retain internal-mould scope, no open shell/tube.

Front -Y: bilateral compression and single projection under overhanging apex; side +X: bent apex, short mildly upturned snorkel fill, sigmoid supra-apical side and broad rugae; top +Z: oval footprint, narrow bilateral mass, centered projection; perspective(1,-1,1): coherent continuous fossil silhouette, not hollow shell or simple cone.
QA checks connected solid surface, no detached projection/rings, no unnecessary holes or invented soft parts; only targeted underside image if needed to verify technical closure.
Clean exactGLB import, finite bounds/transforms, millimeter dimensions expressed in meters, no external buffers/textures, reopen source .blend; report triangles/materials/bytes.
Independent reviewer separate. No live animal behavior, site integration, user acceptance, deployed or GPU/populated-world performance claims.
deliverables: technical report and separate independent QA
prohibited: No public upload/Git/PR/deploy; parent owns private backup.
Stop if historical same-taxon lowpoly exists. No genus/species duplicate count padding.
